look_here_first: Start with texture and leaf arrangement. Roughstem rosinweed is a perennial with very rough, sandpapery leaves and stems, broad sessile leaves, and yellow sunflower-like heads. Use the coarse scabrous surface plus stem-leaf arrangement and peduncle length to separate it from nearby Silphium concepts.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: leaves may be opposite below and alternate above

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: heads relatively close to leafy upper stems compared with longer-peduncled relatives

lookalikes.differences: Compared with S. laciniatum, leaves are broad rather than deeply pinnatifid. Compared with S. integrifolium sensu stricto, S. radula is typically rougher/hairier and may show mixed opposite/alternate leaf arrangement.
